headline: Poliomyelitis in Virginia During 1935
source: American Journal of Public Health and the Nation's Health (via PubMed Central)
blurb: I. C. Riggin published a paper on polio in Virginia during 1935, first read at a public health meeting in St. Louis in November 1935.

headline: Epidemiologic Notes and Reports Transmission of Measles Across State Lines -- Kentucky, New Hampshire, Tennessee, Virginia
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: A measles outbreak linked to one imported case reached 25 cases in four states between November 8, 1981, and January 9, 1982, and 18 of the cases were in Virginia.

headline: HB 1090 Immunizations; regulations by State Board of Health.
blurb: This Virginia law from the 2020 session changed the minimum vaccines required to attend school or child care and took effect on July 1, 2021.

headline: Public Health Actions to Control Measles Among Afghan Evacuees During Operation Allies Welcome — United States, September–November 2021
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: Health officials confirmed 47 measles cases among people evacuated from Afghanistan to the United States in fall 2021, and 22 of those cases were in Virginia.

headline: Widespread Community Transmission of Hepatitis A Virus Following an Outbreak at a Local Restaurant — Virginia, September 2021–September 2022
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: A hepatitis A outbreak in southwestern Virginia in September 2021, linked to an infected food handler, resulted in 51 cases, 31 hospital stays, and three deaths.

headline: Updated: Virginia Health Officials Confirm First 2025 Measles Case in the State
blurb: The Virginia Department of Health reported the state's first measles case of 2025, in a child age 4 or younger in the Northwest Region who had recently traveled internationally.
